keyEvents.text: Goal! Mansfield Town 1, Macclesfield 0. Nathan Moriah-Welsh (Mansfield Town) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by George Maris following a fast break.
George Maris (Mansfield Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Nathan Moriah-Welsh (Mansfield Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Mansfield Town 2, Macclesfield 0. Rhys Oates (Mansfield Town) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner following a fast break.
